nativeSessions.method: isolated profiles driven turn by turn; Claude with --strict-mcp-config and an empty MCP config, plus a logging hook in the isolated profile to prove which host events fired; Codex with the installed mcp.json temporarily pointed at a local stdio mock and restored afterwards; --dangerously-bypass-hook-trust stands in for the one-time /hooks review except in the trust-gate check

scenarios.categories: 26/26: compatible, out_of_range, mismatch, not_installed, absent and no manifest; rules hook only when the SDK is declared; no duplicate on an unchanged prompt

scenarios.telemetry: 2/2: header names 0.3.1 and claude-code; ARKIV_TELEMETRY=off sends none

scenarios.categories: 12/12: the five categories and no manifest, run concurrently
